inputs.x: numerator (or first term of a ratio)

gcf.name: Divide by the GCF
gcf.idea: Find the greatest common factor once and divide both terms by it.

branches.say: Divide the top by the GCF
Divide the bottom by the GCF

repeated.name: Divide out common factors repeatedly
repeated.idea: Keep dividing both terms by any shared factor (2, 3, 5, …) until none is left.
repeated.best_when: The numbers are large and the GCF isn't obvious.

steps.say: Divide both terms by a shared factor until none is left
Divide the top by a shared factor
Divide the bottom by the same factor
